developmentStatement: 1990-2024 US history, including 2000-02, 2008-09, 2020 and 2022, was known to the authors and to the literature before this protocol. It is a development and stress sample, not independent confirmation. Only prospective records can confirm.
market: US (Fama-French Mkt-RF + RF as the investable-market proxy; SPY total return exists only from 2011 in this repository). Korea: source eligibility only, NOT_RUN (Phase D governance).

H1.question: Do FOMC monetary-policy (MP) and central-bank-information (CBI) shocks transmit differently to subsequent equity returns, profit expectations, real yields and risk premia, and is any post-event response predictable?
H1.mechanism: MP: tighter discount rate / risk-bearing capacity -> lower subsequent prices, higher real yields and EBP. CBI: the Fed reveals better growth news -> upward profit-expectation revisions, rates up without a risk-premium rise.
H1.shockScaling: divided by the SD over non-zero months
H1.explanationOutcome: market excess return of the shock month t (partly an identity of the JK sign classification)
H1.predictionOutcomes: cumulative market excess return t+1..t+h, h in {1,3,6,12}
channelOutcomes: SPF fixed-target profit-growth revision at the first survey taken after t
sum of the next four SPF revisions
H1.falsification: H1-P not rejected -> shock origin carries no post-event equity information at the investment horizon; channel results are then reported as mechanism evidence only
descriptive: Bauer-Swanson MPS vs MPS_ORTH 12-month prediction response (MPS_ORTH uses full-sample coefficients: not real time)
H1.investmentTranslation: Run only if H1-P survives Holm; otherwise NOT_RUN_PREDICTION_NOT_SUPPORTED. No rule is specified for it here, so none can be fitted to a result.

H2.question: Does high valuation x profit-expectation cut x credit stress separate future large losses better than valuation alone?

signals.HIGH_PE: MVMA-v1 frozen rule: PE(M) above the mean of 60 prior recorded PE (>=54 valid); Shiller, 4-month quarter-end earnings lag
signals.HIGH_CAPE: CAPE(M) above the mean of 120 prior recorded CAPE (>=108 valid)
signals.EARN_DOWN: latest SPF survey usable at M (from the end of the survey quarter's last month) with fixed-target growth revision log(CPROF5_s/CPROF2_s) - log(CPROF6_{s-1}/CPROF3_{s-1}) < 0
signals.CREDIT_STRESS: MVMA-v1 frozen rule on BAA-GS10: ALFRED as-of 2007-01..2024-08, current vintage lag 1 month earlier
signals.TREND_DOWN: market TR index below its 10-month mean at M
signals.VOL_HIGH: 6-month realised vol above the expanding median of its own history (>=60)

H2.earningsSubstitutionDisclosure: S&P 500 consensus EPS history is SOURCE_BLOCKED. SPF median nominal corporate-profit forecasts are an explicit, pre-specified macro-profit expectation, NOT an S&P EPS forecast.
H2.liquidityDisclosure: NFCI/ANFCI are not point-in-time before 2011 and FCI-G was unreachable: the liquidity leg is BLOCKED and not substituted. 'Credit' is BAA-GS10 only.

outcome.LOSS_h: forward h-month market excess return (compounded market minus compounded risk-free) <= -0.10

H2.walkForward: at month t fit on rows s >= 1970-01 with s + h <= t (outcome matured); refit every month; no random split
H2.missingInputRule: a model whose input is missing at t forecasts the base rate (counted)
H2.H2-P: h = 12: mean Brier loss differential Brier(M_PE) - Brier(M_VULN8) over 1990-01..2024-08 != 0 (HAC lag 11)
H2.falsification: H2-P not rejected, or rejected with M_VULN8 worse -> the interaction does not separate tail risk better than valuation alone
secondary: M_VULN8 vs M0, M_EARN, M_CREDIT, M_ADD, M_CAPE (Brier, HAC lag 11)
conditional loss distribution by the 8 cells (mean, 10th percentile, loss frequency): descriptive

H3.question: Does a better loss forecast improve cost-net ETF allocation once exposure and risk are controlled?
H3.rule: exposure_t from the h = 12 forecast p_t and the base-rate forecast b_t: p < b -> 1.0; b <= p < 2b -> 0.8; p >= 2b -> 0.6; missing -> hold (start 0.8)

policies.HIST_MEAN: M0 forecast through the same map (p = b) -> constant 0.8
policies.TV: M_TV (existing trend/volatility information) through the map

H3.returns: weight set at the end of t, earned over month t+1 (market vs risk-free), 1990-02..2024-09
H3.costs: 2bp one-way on both legs per unit of exposure change (decomposition COST); stress x2, x3
H3.H3-P: VULN cost-net TIMING (vs its exposure-matched static) != 0, annualised, HAC lag 0
H3.falsification: H3-P not rejected -> a forecast improvement, if any, does not transmit to allocation value

robustness: all signals lagged one extra month

harness.oneShot: results/EXECUTION-STARTED.json is written before the first outcome read; its presence or any result refuses a second run
harness.atomicOutput: a single results JSON written via temp file and rename after all computation
lessonsFrom359: every registered metric present or explicitly null

notRun: free-form nonlinear ML (sample of ~4 recessions; Welch-Goyal / Gu-Kelly-Xiu)
